hero.title: Fabrice Reynaud, freelance Tech Lead.
bio: I am a freelance Tech Lead, based in [TODO: region], and I work mostly remotely. For 15 years, I have been building, connecting and putting systems back on their feet: e-commerce, information systems, IoT platforms.
My job: join a project that is stalling, understand what is blocking it, and give the team back a framework where shipping becomes simple again.

portrait.avatarAlt: The Sekoya Solutions avatar: the logo, a tree whose roots form a circuit, in a golden ring.

items.title: Rigour
items.text: Tests, CI, reviews. Not on principle: because that is what makes releases boring, and therefore reliable.

items.title: Transparency
items.text: My repositories are public, my decisions are written down (ADRs), my measurements are published. You see what I see.

items.title: Pragmatism
items.text: The right level of tooling for your team, not that of a large corporation. I prefer a simple solution that holds to a brilliant one that breaks.

bring.title: What I bring to my clients.
items: A clear diagnosis within a few days
A technical framework the team makes its own
A documented handover: you do not depend on me

ai.title: How I work with AI
ai.lead: Every day I use Claude Code and Cursor, with the latest models from Anthropic and xAI, as well as Grok and Grok Imagine for mockups and visuals. They help me go faster; they decide nothing.

steps.title: Frame
steps.text: I decide the architecture and write the decision down (ADR).

steps.title: Generate
steps.text: The agent proposes, following rules written in AGENTS.md.

steps.title: Review and test
steps.text: I review every line; the tests and the CI must pass.

items.text: Automated tests that guard every change.
Recorded decisions, one per technical choice.
I answer for every line shipped, whether I wrote it or an agent did.
Transparency: my Transit and Parts projects state explicitly that code is written by agents under my direction; the rules are in their AGENTS.md files.

closing.title: A project that's stalling? Let's talk.
closing.text: A first conversation to understand your situation, with no commitment.
